moneyNote: All amounts are game values for balancing, not real costs.

design.heading: Rover design
design.tutorial: Select one part for each slot. Mass and size set the launch ticket tier. Light parts cost more.
design.overTopTier: Exceeds the Large ticket limits. The rover cannot launch.
design.overBudget: Total cost exceeds the available budget.
design.chassisOverloaded: Total mass exceeds the chassis maximum load. The frame will take damage during the mission.
design.belowMinimum: The balance is below the minimum budget for this mission. The mission cannot start.

ticket.heading: Launch ticket
ticket.briefing: REL secures a spot for the rover on the next commercial launch to the lunar south pole.

landing.heading: Landing
landing.briefing: The lander has touched down on the de Gerlache crater rim. The rover is deploying.

mission.heading: Mission
mission.briefing: Fourteen days of daylight. The Sun stays low and circles the horizon.
mission.controls: W A S D or arrow keys to drive. Space to brake.

debrief.heading: Mission debrief
debrief.survived: The rover completed the full mission.
debrief.failedRound: The balance is below the minimum budget for the next mission. The round must be restarted.
debrief.passedRound: The balance meets the minimum budget for the next mission.

history.survived: ISRO's Pragyan rover completed its planned mission of one lunar daylight period in 2023.
history.energy: NASA's Opportunity rover lost power in 2018 when a planet-wide dust storm blocked sunlight from its solar panels.
history.stuck: NASA's Spirit rover became stuck in soft soil on Mars in 2009 and never drove free.
history.froze: India's Vikram lander and Pragyan rover did not wake after the cold lunar night in 2023.
history.destroyed: The Soviet Lunokhod 2 rover was lost in 1973 after lunar dust covered its radiator and it overheated.

marsSoon.heading: Mars: coming soon
marsSoon.body: The Moon campaign is complete. Research points carry forward to Mars technology.
